description: Find dishes at a named venue, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro", dietary_tags=["vegan"], allergens=["milk"]. Filter by text, tags, allergens or max_price; unfiltered, item lists its dietary tags, example dishes and allergen counts. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

allergens.description: Exclude items declaring any of these allergens (case- and separator-insensitive (gluten free = gluten-free); synonyms match: milk, lactose and dairy all match dairy; pass one term).

city.description: Disambiguate a name by city (call list_cities); ignored for a slug.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

dietary_tags.description: A JSON array, e.g. ["gluten-free"]: items must carry ALL of these tags; case- and separator-insensitive (gluten free = gluten-free).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

max_price.description: Only items priced at or under this, in the menu's currency.

query.description: Text matched in item name, description, section and menu names; every word must match; connector words (and, with, in) aren't required.

venue.description: Venue name or slug; call search_venues to discover one.

name: venue_menu

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: A venue's menu by name
